meta.name: HORROR COLLECTOR
meta.description: Not all urban legends are myths. Some are real, and they’re coming to life. Fushigi roams Japan in a red hood, sealing them inside his magical notebook, with Jimmy, his human-faced dog, by his side. Each phenomenon brings him one step closer to capturing Himitsu, the girl responsible for manifesting the supernatural beings.

videos.title: The Red Notebook
videos.overview: Rumors spread about a mysterious figure in a hood as people start noticing surreal and terrifying apparitions.

videos.title: The Shadow Enveloping the City
videos.overview: Several girls hear a voice in the woods and notice a strange woman lurking in the background of their photos.

videos.title: The Faceless Kid
videos.overview: Fushigi's search for Himitsu leads him to the publishers Jimmy worked at while he was still completely human.

videos.title: The Quiet Ripples
videos.overview: Fushigi and Jimmy track down a cursed cell phone app that tricks users into committing risky and violent acts.

videos.title: Blood-Soaked Feelings
videos.overview: Jimmy and Fushigi try to save a girl curious about urban legends and a boy haunted by an amnesiac ghost.

videos.title: The Wandering Dog
videos.overview: Jimmy is turning into a Human-Faced Dog. Can Fushigi find a way to save him?

videos.title: A Frenzy of Cruelty
videos.overview: During two urban legend encounters, a girl meets a boy with a missing sister who is desperate to find Fushigi.
